events.title: Node.js 14 released
events.summary: Node.js 14.0.0 shipped on April 21, 2020 with optional chaining in V8 8.1, diagnostic reports, and improved async hooks.
events.about: Node 14 became LTS in October 2020 — the runtime behind pandemic-era remote tooling and e-commerce spikes. Optional chaining and nullish coalescing worked natively without transpilation; experimental native fetch arrived in later 14.x releases.

narrative.whyChosen: Node 14 LTS carried production workloads through the 2020–2021 surge in web traffic.
narrative.whyImportant: Modern JS syntax in V8 reduced Babel dependency for server code.
narrative.problemSolved: Teams wanted ES2020 operators on the server without extra compile steps.

events.title: ZEIT rebranded as Vercel
events.summary: Guillermo Rauch rebranded ZEIT to Vercel on April 21, 2020 — alongside a $21M Series A focused on the develop-preview-ship workflow for Jamstack sites.
events.about: Vercel unified the company's identity with its hosting platform and Next.js — preview deployments for every Git push, edge functions, and serverless SSR. The rebrand signaled ambition beyond deployment tooling to owning the frontend cloud.

narrative.whyChosen: Vercel became the default frontend cloud for Next.js and Jamstack teams.
narrative.whyImportant: Preview deployments per PR changed how teams ship frontend code.
narrative.problemSolved: Frontend teams lacked integrated develop-preview-deploy workflows tied to Git.

sources.title: Vercel Blog — ZEIT is now Vercel (April 21, 2020)
